text: Designed a time-dependent A* routing engine over Boston's real road network (11,409 nodes, 26,083 edges) incorporating real-time traffic conditions
Trained LightGBM models on 4.3M traffic samples using 21 engineered temporal, spatial, and weather features, which helped achieve 27s MAE and R² of 0.89
Visualized routes and traffic predictions on an interactive Streamlit map, layering real-time congestion overlays to validate model outputs against actual road conditions
